name: Prisma Lenz
tradeable: unranked only, no Forma or Catalyst

groups.activity: crack Void Relics, trade Prime parts for Ducats
groups.mode: squad of four for more reward picks

rows.label: Ducats
rows.note: trade Prime parts and blueprints at any Relay Ducat Kiosk except Maroo's Bazaar

conditions: The kiosk is open even when Baro isn't there, so bank Ducats ahead of his visit; his window is only 48 hours.
Bronze parts are worth 15 ducats, silver 45, gold 100 (25/65 for parts downgraded from vaulted relics); 575 is about six gold parts.
bonuses: Capture first, then Exterminate on a small tileset, or Void Cascade with a group that knows it, were named as the fastest fissures.
Defense fissures double as relic income since waves drop more relics; a squad gets four reward picks per relic.

disclosures.title: where not to get ducats
disclosures.body: Aya to Ducats at Varzia during Prime Resurgence is 5 ducats per Aya, a poor rate useful only for leftover Aya.

rows.label: Prisma Lenz
rows.note: arrives built and ready to equip; no Foundry step
rows.alt: or a TennoCon relay visit with Baro's Relay Ticket

conditions: Baro's stock changes every visit; the Prisma Lenz isn't guaranteed even when he is. Check any Ducat Kiosk countdown to see which relay he's visiting.
MR 12 is needed to equip it, and to receive it in a trade.
It's hidden from the Codex and unmastered list until you own it.

disclosures.title: why it's still worth grabbing
disclosures.body: It's a stat bump over the regular Lenz (charge time, status, crit multiplier) with a big looks upgrade, but Kuva Bramma outclasses it as a weapon. For MR it's a cheap buy: the only real cost is waiting for Baro to carry it.
